1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S.–Iran tensions remain volatile as another incident hits the Strait of Hormuz: Trump said at the U.N. General Assembly on Tuesday that the U.S. would either reach a deal with Iran or "annihilate" Iran. He later said that U.S. and Iranian representatives had held a "very good" three-hour meeting and hinted that an agreement would have to wait until after the midterm elections. Iran’s military responded that it was prepared to launch even more forceful strikes. On Wednesday, the U.K. Maritime Trade Operations agency, UKMTO, reported that a cargo vessel caught fire and drifted after being struck by an "unknown projectile" in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in 2 casualties. Iranian President Pezeshkian is scheduled to address the U.N. General Assembly today. Oil prices rebounded accordingly: USO closed down 2.77% on Tuesday but rose 1.35% premarket today.
  • Diesel export ban enters feasibility assessment: Trump said Tuesday that he supported restricting diesel exports, while Bessent said officials were assessing whether a full or partial ban would be feasible. White House officials had previously denied that such a move was under consideration, and Republican senators are also divided on the issue.
  • Treasury yield nears 5% as safe-haven assets weaken: The 10-year Treasury yield edged higher, once again approaching the 5% threshold. GLD fell 1.19% premarket. The broader market weakened modestly before the open: SPY 772.82 (-0.08%, last trade at 08:33), QQQ 746.04 (-0.19%). On Tuesday, QQQ closed at 747.43 (+0.81%, intraday high 748.31), SPY closed essentially flat at 773.44, and DIA fell 0.36%, showing clear divergence among the indices.
  • Trump–Xi White House summit and Meta Connect fall on the same day: Xi Jinping is skipping the U.N. General Assembly and instead traveling to Washington for a summit with Trump, with Iran, Taiwan, and trade among the topics. Meta Connect is also being held today, and Zuckerberg is expected to provide further details on the Muse AI agent. META surged as high as 757.14 intraday Tuesday before closing at 736.60 (-0.63%), a substantial reversal from its high. September flash PMI will be released at 9:45 a.m. ET.
  • Quantum stocks rally collectively premarket while semiconductors pull back modestly: After Tuesday’s close, IonQ unveiled a real-time quantum error-correction decoder running on a single CPU and announced a Superion 256 partnership with South Korea’s SDT. IONQ traded at 45.37 (+11.36%) premarket, while RGTI rose 5.44%. In semiconductors, MU closed Tuesday at 1095.47 (+4.98%, high 1097.17), once again failing to touch 1100, and traded at 1091.69 (-0.35%) premarket. SOXX fell 1.18% premarket, while AVGO also declined 1.18%.
